//: OPTIONAL overlay for environments where outbound HTTPS goes through a TLS-terminating proxy (corporate egress, sandboxed CI). Not needed on a normal machine. Pass it AFTER the main config: --config config/config.dry.json --config config/proxy-overlay.json
//why: ccxt sets trust_env=False on both its requests session and its aiohttp session, so the standard REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE / SSL_CERT_FILE / HTTPS_PROXY variables are ignored and TLS verification fails against the proxy CA. Enabling trust_env makes ccxt honour them. TLS verification stays ON.
